candidate_row.source: Chromium 155.0.8059.84 WebDriver BiDi file-dialog surface - the chromium-bidi mapper bundled in the Chromium source tree - https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/155.0.8059.84/third_party/chromium-bidi/src/bidiMapper/modules/context/BrowsingContextImpl.ts
candidate_row.scope: How Chromium's own production BiDi client answers the file-chooser surface that CDP exposes: the CDP Page.fileChooserOpened event converted into the BiDi input.fileDialogOpened event, the mode->multiple mapping, the element binding through the shared id, and the input.setFiles command that delivers files to the opened input
candidate_row.anchor: tag 155.0.8059.84, third_party/chromium-bidi/src/bidiMapper/modules/context/BrowsingContextImpl.ts:432-467 (CDP Page.fileChooserOpened handler; element bound at 445-453 by getSharedId(this.id, this.#loaderId, params.backendNodeId); multiple at 461 = params.mode === 'selectMultiple'); src/bidiMapper/modules/script/SharedId.ts:20-26 (shared id shape f.<frameId>.d.<documentId>.e.<backendNodeId>); src/bidiMapper/modules/input/InputProcessor.ts:76-254 (input.setFiles; multiple guard at 104; DOM.setFileInputFiles at 230; zero-length fallback at 152-157 and untrusted-event note at 235); src/bidiMapper/modules/cdp/CdpTarget.ts:213-222 (Page.enable enableFileChooserOpenedEvent and Page.setInterceptFileChooserDialog enabled=true cancel=true at arming); src/bidiMapper/CommandProcessor.ts:424-425 (input.setFiles route)
candidate_row.teaches: Chromium's own BiDi layer answers a file chooser through the element, not through the browser-assigned id: it converts the CDP backendNodeId into a shared id qualified by frame id AND document id, so the same backendNodeId in another document is a different element. It maps the CDP mode to a boolean multiple exactly as the input's multiple attribute dictates, and it refuses more than one file on a non-multiple input. It also shows that the zero-length array is special (DOM.setFileInputFiles does not update the files), and that the resulting events are not trusted. This is the strongest next-frontier source because it is a pinned-revision primary source in the lane's own Chromium that exercises the exact same CDP surface the r78 driver measures, and it names the drift that r78 observed: the id is only meaningful once qualified by the document it was issued in.
